evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.
